tagline: Melee battle-mage: Stormstrike, Flurry, Maelstrom Weapon and Rage of the Farseer on Intellect-fed Attack Power.
verdict: Enhancement is the spec Blizzard rebuilt the most. Mental Dexterity turns 100% of your Intellect into Attack Power, Mental Quickness adds spell damage and healing equal to 30% of Intellect, Maelstrom Weapon makes Lightning Bolt cheaper and faster from your melee hits, and the 31-point capstone Rage of the Farseer is a 30% attack speed cooldown (the Sep-24 patch stripped its spell casting speed component). The result is a hybrid that wears whatever Intellect/Strength gear drops.

Public placement is split: a player-posted forum list put it in S, Overgear and MMOExp put it in B (wowforever.co aggregation). Icy Veins says it is "effective, but needs to grow into its talent tree" and was Mana-starved at the level-20 beta cap, because Improved Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon were unreachable. That is why this build goes straight down the center column: Thundering Strikes, Mental Dexterity, Flurry, Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon in order.

Elemental Devastation (3/3, +9% melee crit for 10 sec after a spell crit) and Concussion come out of the Elemental tree because Icy Veins says the former is meant for Enhancement. Tidal Focus gives the +5% Hit melee needs. Everything is a projection until level 60 items and raids are live.
strengths: Mental Dexterity and Mental Quickness let Intellect gear double as Attack Power and Spell Power, so gear options are broad.
Rage of the Farseer is a personal 30% attack speed cooldown that also speeds up Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Stormstrike sits at a much lower level than in Classic with a shorter cooldown (about 8 sec per Icy Veins), and Improved Stormstrike can reset it on Dodge or Parry.
Windfury Totem is called a must-have melee buff by Icy Veins, and Enhancement brings strong off-healing between pulls.
weaknesses: Mana is the leash: Icy Veins notes swing timers are slow, costs are high and the tree only rounds out deep.
Weapon DPS is the top stat; Icy Veins advises slow two-handers, so your upgrades depend heavily on which weapons actually drop.
Sep-24 totem nerfs: Flametongue Totem no longer stacks with Flametongue Weapon or Windfury Totem, and Windfury/Grace of Air/Tranquil Air don't stack across Shamans, so you compete for the Air slot.
Public tier lists disagree wildly (S on the forum, B on seller lists), and none has tested it at 60.

pvp.title: Enhancement PvP: Toughness Windfury Bruiser (8 / 43 / 0)
pvp.summary: Melee battleground burst: full Enhancement tree minus the leveling filler, with Toughness for Stamina, Improved Ghost Wolf for instant mobility and Guardian Totems to shorten Grounding Totem.

stats.note: Our projection. Icy Veins ranks Weapon DPS first for PvE and Crit above Strength; we move Stamina up for 15v15 survivability. Expertise reduces the chance attacks are dodged or parried (Blizzard, Method).

alliance.why: Only Alliance Shaman race. Stoneform removes bleeds, poisons and diseases and trims Physical damage 10%, ideal against Rogues and Warriors; Mace Specialization gives +1% crit with a mace.

horde.why: Hardiness cuts stun duration 20% (Icy Veins: a game-changer against stun classes), Blood Fury is a 10% Attack Power burst, Axe Specialization adds +1% crit with an axe.

playstyle: Role: burst melee and flag-room bruiser. Jump the enemy carrier or healer, Stormstrike, then Earth Shock; Stormstrike's 20% bonus applies to the next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock, so line up Maelstrom Weapon casts behind it.

Rage of the Farseer (+30% attack speed for 25 sec; Icy Veins says it is a 3 minute cooldown) is your opener on a pushed node or flag carrier. Flurry adds 25% attack speed for 3 swings after each melee crit.
Improved Ghost Wolf makes Ghost Wolf instant and usable everywhere, so you can chase or disengage at will. Ghost Wolf gives +40% speed (Icy Veins); you cannot do damage while wolfed.
Frost Shock is your slow, Earth Shock your interrupt, and Earthbind Totem slows nearby enemies. Guardian Totems also trims 2 sec from Grounding Totem.
Spirit Weapons adds Parry. Toughness adds 10% Stamina, enough for flag room fights. Stoneform (Dwarf) or Hardiness (Orc) are the cooldowns that decide stun-heavy fights.
Drop Battle Standard (Rank 7) when your team pushes a choke or a node; it grants allies nearby 15% max health.
No arenas or rated PvP exist in Forever; plan for Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Darkspear Islands, Alterac Valley and world PvP.

pvp.gearNote: Rank 2 Insignia Trinket first (3,500 Honor, +2,000 for the Epic version) and the Rank 3 Faction Cloak (10 Arathi Basin Marks + 3,000 Honor) are the cheap early wins. Rank 7 opens the Battle Standard (15% max health aura, 10 min cooldown) for flag-room and node pushes. The Elite pieces unlock Wrist/Waist (R8), Boots (R9), Gloves (R10), Legs/Shoulders (R12) and Chest/Helm (R13), with Rare PvP gear requiring level 55 and Marks of Honor from the matching battleground. Rank 14 opens the weapon arsenal: pick a slow two-hander (Icy Veins' Weapon DPS advice); cost is 15,000 Honor + 20 Alterac Valley Marks or 8,000 Honor + 10 Darkspear Islands Marks (beta prices, datamined).

pve.title: Enhancement PvE: Maelstrom Battle-Mage (8 / 33 / 10)
pve.summary: Level-60 dungeon and raid-prep Enhancement: center-column Stormstrike/Flurry/Maelstrom Weapon path with Hit from Tidal Focus, Elemental Devastation and Concussion on top.

stats.note: Icy Veins' Enhancement ranking (level-20 beta); they warn endgame values will change once Hit and Expertise gear exists. Hit and Crit are unified spell/melee stats. Icy Veins: 1 Strength is 2 Attack Power, 1 Intellect is 1 Attack Power via Mental Dexterity plus Mana and spell crit.

alliance.why: Only Alliance Shaman race. Mace Specialization (+1% crit with a mace) matches slow two-hander maces; Stoneform is a self-cleanse for poison/disease/bleed fights.

horde.why: Blood Fury (+10% Attack Power and Spell Power for 15 sec) stacks with Rage of the Farseer, and Axe Specialization (+1% crit with an axe) fits slow two-hand axes. Icy Veins' go-to pick for Horde Shaman.

playstyle: Keep Windfury Weapon on your two-hander. Use Rockbiter Weapon only when solo and Flametongue Weapon in groups (Icy Veins), because Spirit Weapons is not in this build and Rockbiter adds threat.

Drop all four totems with Call of the Elements: Strength of Earth, Mana Spring, Searing Totem and an Air totem (Windfury Totem or Grace of Air Totem), per the community rotation draft on wowtbc.gg. Sep-24: Flametongue Totem, Windfury Totem and Tranquil Air no longer stack with each other.

Priority (community draft, untested): Rage of the Farseer with on-use trinkets, Lightning Bolt at 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, Stormstrike on cooldown, then Earth Shock (preferred when Flame Shock is already ticking) or Flame Shock.
Stormstrike makes the next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock deal 20% more, so cast your Maelstrom Weapon Lightning Bolt right after it.
Elemental Devastation gives +9% melee crit for 10 sec after a spell crit, and Flurry turns melee crits into 25% attack speed for 3 swings, so Earth Shock/Lightning Bolt crits feed your melee.
Improved Stormstrike gives 50% mana regeneration while casting for 15 sec after each Stormstrike, so use Stormstrike on cooldown.
Enhancement can off-heal with Healing Wave between pulls; Spirit Weapons plus Rockbiter can even off-tank in a pinch (Icy Veins), but this build prioritises damage.

leveling.title: Enhancement Leveling: Stormstrike at 25, Maelstrom Weapon at 36
leveling.summary: Respec-free 10-60 path: Thundering Strikes, Mental Dexterity and Shamanistic Focus by 20 (Icy Veins' level-20 goals), Stormstrike at 25, Rage of the Farseer at 41.

stats.note: Classic WoW Forever's beta-client guide lists Weapon Damage, Strength, Crit, Intellect, Agility; Icy Veins: weapon DPS is the primary damage source, and 'of the Gorilla' greens suit Enhancement.

alliance.why: Only Alliance Shaman race. Big Game Hunter (+5% vs Beasts) is useful during questing, and Stoneform handles poison and bleed mobs.

horde.why: Icy Veins' Enhancement guide calls out Plainsrunning (up to +30% movement speed) for exploring before mounts; Endurance also adds 5% Health and 1% Hit.

playstyle: Levels 10-20: Thundering Strikes, Ancestral Knowledge, Mental Dexterity and Shamanistic Focus. Shamanistic Focus (-45% Shock and Lightning Shield mana) is the 11th point at level 20; Improved Ghost Wolf follows once Ghost Wolf unlocks.
Use Rockbiter Weapon when solo (it lasts 60 minutes in Forever) and Flametongue Weapon in dungeons to avoid threat problems; Windfury Weapon waits until 30.
Stormstrike from level 25 (Icy Veins says it is much earlier than Classic with an 8 sec cooldown); Improved Stormstrike at 32 for Mana regeneration.
Heal yourself between pulls with Healing Wave (Icy Veins); finish enemies with auto-attacks if mana is low.
Maelstrom Weapon lands at 36-40 and Rage of the Farseer at 41. Spirit Weapons comes at 50 as a dungeon safety valve.

The last 10 levels are Totemic Focus and Tidal Focus, which become a 5% Hit and cheaper totems; the build ends identical to the Restoration/Elemental splash in PvE except for Ghost Wolf and Spirit Weapons.
